summary: Stage 4.5 Weekly Digest (Resend) — full backend + frontend testing. All 16 pytest cases passed; UI flows on /settings/digest verified end-to-end including a real Resend send to the sandbox recipient. Stage 1-4 regression endpoints all 200 OK. Final digest config restored to recipients=[info@gippslandholidays.com.au], enabled=true, send_day=1, send_hour=8, send_minute=0, timezone=Australia/Sydney.
critical_code_review_comments: digest_service.run_digest catches `Exception as e` and persists the full exception string as `error` in digest_log; that's fine for live debugging but consider classifying Resend 403 sandbox errors distinctly so the UI can surface a clearer 'sandbox restriction' message instead of a raw exception.

/api/digest/run webhook returns plain text `sent: <id>` or `skipped: <reason>` — for a failed Resend send the current code still returns `failed: ` (no reason) because run_digest's failure path doesn't populate result['reason']; consider surfacing result.get('error') in the plain-text response for easier cron-job.org debugging.

ensure_digest_settings persists DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy() — the in-memory dict shares list references (e.g. `recipients: []`) across calls; safe today because list isn't mutated in-place, but worth using copy.deepcopy for safety.

DigestSettings.jsx: recipient chip uses email as key — adding the same email twice is prevented but trimming/normalisation only happens client-side on add; the server-side lowercase+trim is the source of truth (good).
seed_data_creation: none — used existing reservations/guests in DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stage 4.5 endpoints fully covered in /app/backend/tests/test_stage45_digest.py (uses live Resend API; only sends to info@gippslandholidays.com.au sandbox).
